text: A spacer-tech shuttle designed for transit between surface and orbit, or between moons of a planetary system. This one seems to be non-functional.
The Imperial maxpack is a formidable armored transport truck, known for its impressive cargo capacity. This one seems to be non-functional.
A small-sized box containing uranium slug ammunition. Used by Kontarion turrets to reload. May explode when damaged. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic slugs.
A small-sized box containing autocannon ammunition. Used by Palintone turrets to reload. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic slugs.
A small-sized box containing missiles. Used by Onager turrets to reload. Upon closer inspection this box seems to be just filled with plastic missiles.
A small imperial crate containing valuables. Sealed shut.
A small imperial crate containing extremely valuable items. Sealed shut.
A large pillar with a series of sensors, cameras and motion detectors. Seems to be inactive.
A large military crate of aerodrone munitions. Upon closer inspection, all the missiles are fake plastic ones.
A large, overcharged aerodrone battery. Non-functional.
Aerodrone is a spacer-tech, unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with advanced sensors and a missile payload. Non-functional.
A large fuel tank used to refuel Imperial shuttles. Completely empty.
A large console designed to link to surrounding surveillance pillars. This one is disconnected from the grid.
An imperial computer interface. This one is disconnected from the grid.
The Techprinter is a marvel of technological innovation, designed to capture and preserve the intricate knowledge residing within a techfriar’s mind. This one is disconnected from the grid.
A compact stack of discs crafted from the enigmatic element known as techite, produced exclusively by the Empire for knowledge transcribing. These are all blank.
An underground hydroponics basic used by the empire to feed their subjects. Upon closer inspection it is disconnected from the water mains and all its plants are made of plastic.
A large node connecting all the nearby water mains. Upon closer inspection it is disconnected from the water grid.
An advanced shielding apparatus. Seems to be inactive.
This terminal serves as the primary interface for operating the Zeus Cannon batteries. Seems to be inactive.
A capacitor bank that transforms electricity into raw energy for the Zeus cannon. Seems to be inactive.
A relic of ancient Sophiamundan technology, the Zeus Cannon is a closely guarded secret of the Empire. Wait, what is this? It's... made of cardboard!
A deserter device capable of intercepting imperial communication. Seems to be inactive.
